label: Ikony · Pulp Fiction twist
desc: Líný twist, ‚V‘ přes oči, plavání se stisknutým nosem, stopařské palce, podřep a zpět, ukázání na kameru.
desc_en: A lazy twist, the V across the eyes, the swim with a pinched nose, hitchhiker thumbs, down into a squat and back, a point at the camera.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer does a lazy slow twist with knees bent, arms hanging loose at the waist, a sleepy half-lidded expression, and keeps twisting gently
two fingers in a V shape sweep horizontally across the eyes from one side to the other while the head follows them, and end beside the face
the arms stroke alternately in front of the body like swimming, then one hand pinches the nose as the body dips down as if under water, and comes back up
both thumbs jerk over the shoulders like a hitchhiker, alternating left and right in rhythm, and end with one thumb up
the twisting sinks into a deep squat and slowly rises back up, arms swinging, and ends standing
the dancer stops and points one finger straight at the camera with a lazy smirk, and holds
